Source counter: page claims 233 total shipments; 5 individual rows actually rendered on the free view (dates 2026-01-28 to 2026-02-16), plus port-lane counts (ISLAMABAD 20, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 14, SAHAR AIR 8, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC 6, LAHORE 4) and "Latest Cargo 2026-02-16". Destinations seen: Russia (Sheremetyevo), Pakistan (Islamabad, Lahore). HS codes actually shipped: 29362310, 29420033, 29420090, 29280090 — NOT the declared 293399.

note: Real, dated export shipments are confirmed from Indian customs records — this is not a website claim. The company is an exporter of veterinary/pharma API raw materials (riboflavin sodium phosphate, oxyclozanide, oxfenadazole, closantel base, triclabendazole) by air from Sahar Air Cargo (Mumbai) mainly to Pakistan and Russia, with bill-of-lading/awb numbers visible (9724594, 9604996, 9588266, 9221049, 9147692). HS discrepancy: declared 293399 (heterocyclic compounds) does not match the codes on the actual shipment records (29362310, 29420033, 29420090, 29280090 — organo-sulphur/other organic compounds and vitamins). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views — left null, not invented. Domestic (India) supply activity is unverified, not denied: 'следов поставок не найдено' on the domestic side only because the sources were inaccessible, so status is unknown rather than none_found. Role: manufacturer_trader (own pharma API product lines, but also trades under bank L/C to order).
